bullets.id: Emas spot membuka pekan dengan naik tipis ke sekitar $4.175, naik 0,20% sehari menurut Trading Economics, setelah sempat ke sekitar $4.183 pada Senin pagi. Jumat lalu emas ditutup di $4.164,10 di New York, turun 0,14%, setelah gagal bertahan di dekat puncak sesi $4.199,50 saat aksi jual saham teknologi meluas.
bullets.en: Spot gold opened the week slightly higher near $4,175, up 0.20% on the day according to Trading Economics, after touching about $4,183 on Monday morning. Last Friday gold closed at $4,164.10 in New York, down 0.14%, after failing to hold near its $4,199.50 session high as a tech selloff deepened.

bullets.id: Peluang Fed menahan suku bunga pada rapat 27–28 Oktober sekitar 83–84%, naik dari 72%, setelah Ketua Fed Kevin Warsh tidak memberi sinyal kenaikan. Yield 10 tahun ditutup di 5,097% dan dolar melemah sepekan untuk pertama kali dalam lima pekan, tetapi Brent di $109,86 dan WTI di atas $100 menjaga kekhawatiran inflasi. Emas turun sekitar 3,9% sebulan.
bullets.en: The odds of a Fed hold at the October 27–28 meeting are about 83–84%, up from 72%, after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh gave no hike signal. The 10-year yield closed at 5.097% and the dollar fell on the week for the first time in five weeks, but Brent at $109.86 and WTI above $100 keep inflation worries alive. Gold is down about 3.9% on the month.

bullets.id: Level teknikal: resistance $4.185–$4.195 lalu $4.215–$4.227, support $4.141–$4.150, $4.104–$4.113 dan $4.064–$4.074. Agenda pekan ini: housing starts (Selasa), klaim pengangguran (Kamis), PMI flash Oktober (Jumat), lalu rapat Fed 27–28 Oktober.
bullets.en: Technical levels: resistance at $4,185–$4,195, then $4,215–$4,227; support at $4,141–$4,150, $4,104–$4,113 and $4,064–$4,074. This week’s agenda: housing starts (Tuesday), jobless claims (Thursday), October flash PMIs (Friday), then the October 27–28 Fed meeting.

bullets.en: Antam rose Rp2,000 to Rp2,574,000/gram, a third daily gain, with buyback up Rp2,000 to Rp2,389,000 (spread about 7.2%). Galeri24 held at Rp2,523,000 (buyback Rp2,375,000, spread about 5.9%) and UBS held at Rp2,548,000 (buyback Rp2,349,000, spread about 7.8%).
